Scene: fruit salad with mixed greens and roasted sweet potato/vegetable side, overhead view.
Vessel: square white plate ~26 cm side, approx 26 x 26 = 676 cm^2 (treating as dinner plate area ~530 cm^2 for round equivalent; using visible rim, ~560 cm^2)

Fruit pieces (melon, watermelon, cantaloupe, honeydew, berries):
melon and fruit cubes: 38% -> 213 cm^2 x 3 = 639 ml x 0.6 = 383 g x 40 = 153 kcal
Mixed berries (blackberries, strawberries, blueberries, raspberries): 8% -> 45 cm^2 x 1.5 = 67 ml x 0.6 = 40 g x 45 = 18 kcal
Mixed greens (lettuce, spinach): 17% -> 95 cm^2 x 2 = 190 ml x 0.15 = 29 g x 20 = 6 kcal
Broccoli florets: 8% -> 45 cm^2 x 2.5 = 112 ml x 0.6 = 67 g x 34 = 23 kcal
Roasted sweet potato cubes: 9% -> 50 cm^2 x 2 = 100 ml x 0.9 = 90 g x 90 = 81 kcal

Check: about 80% covered, roughly 0.8 x 560 = 450 cm^2 food area, total about 790 g, 281 kcal. Fruit and vegetables are low energy, so the total is plausible for a fruit-heavy salad side with a few hundred grams of produce. Note that the density-based fruit mass (383 g melon) is generous; the sum of ~620 g is high for this plate, so I'll keep the estimate at the lower end of plausible ranges.

Revised: melon/fruit 330 g, berries 40 g, greens 29 g, broccoli 67 g, sweet potato 90 g. Total ~556 g, ~250 kcal.
